message: No detected input validation: The code defines ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS and MAX_FILE_SIZE constants but never uses them to actually validate uploaded file types, sizes, schema, dtypes, or value ranges before processing.

No detected untrusted source handling: The code does not fetch data from any remote source (URL, S3, HuggingFace, etc.) and therefore performs no checksum verification, authentication, or integrity checks.
No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution comparison, expected label set validation, or label-noise detection tool is used anywhere in the visible code.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preparation functions only perform type conversions, resampling, grouping, and rolling statistics; there is no outlier detection, statistical anomaly check, or filtering of suspicious inputs.

No detected model integrity verification: The code does not load any pretrained weights or serialized models, and there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision anywhere in the visible code slice.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample detection before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the visible training code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TF Privacy, DP-SGD) or mechanisms are imported or used in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries or techniques (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) are imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of a held-out test set isolation, signed/hashed evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation; metrics like MAE and MSE are imported but no protective isolation mechanism is visible in the code.

No detected input sanitization: The code performs string cleaning and type conversions (e.g., replacing commas) but does no shape/range validation, schema checking, or rejection of malformed inputs before passing data to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: The truncated code shows no guards on model outputs such as NaN checks, probability bounds, or threshold validation before returning results.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline uses tabular/time-series ML models (XGBoost, LinearRegression, etc.), not LLMs, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and not present.
